axis.description: int or tuple of ints Position in the expanded axes where the new axis (or axes) is placed.
constraints: --> deprecated: Passing an axis where `axis > a.ndim` will be treated as `axis == a.ndim`, and passing `axis < -a.ndim - 1` will be treated as `axis == 0`.

output.description: ------- ndarray View of `a` with the number of dimensions increased.
